'''Ferro-magnesium armor plate''' was a type of [[enhanced carbon-durasteel armor]] available for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was composed of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] nanotubes and [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
